text: ∀x (Satellite(x) → (OrbitsEarth(x) ∧ TransmitsData(x) ∧ ReceivesData(x) ∧ EnablesServices(x, WeatherForecasting ∧ GlobalPositioning ∧ Communication))) ::: A satellite orbits Earth, transmitting and receiving data, enabling services such as weather forecasting, global positioning, and communication.
